verdict.rationale: Algolia ships InstantSearch UI libraries for vanilla JS and React, plus a Distributed Search Network that routes queries to the nearest servers. Hands-on reports call it blazing fast and say it beat Elasticsearch and Solr on speed. Users also describe instant results in DocSearch and live-search UIs, though one HN report of occasional slowness suggests implementations can vary. missing for 10: first-party documentation of millisecond latency figures or benchmarks, explicit docs stating results update on every keystroke.
